$comment: Skills each scenario can test. Scenarios list 1-2 skill ids in enc.skills (primary first). icon = a name in web/js/ui.js.

skills.name: Sender and domain checks
skills.description: Spot lookalike senders and domains, like novac0rp.com or a vendor's new address.

skills.name: Links and QR codes
skills.description: Check where a link or QR code really goes before you open it or sign in.

skills.name: Attachments and macros
skills.description: Treat unexpected files, .html invoices and macro documents as suspect.

skills.name: Phone and voice scams
skills.description: Verify callers, even convincing ones, by calling back on a known number.

skills.name: Text and chat scams
skills.description: Question texts and chats from new numbers or external accounts.

skills.name: MFA prompts and one-time codes
skills.description: Never share a one-time code or approve a sign-in you didn't start.

skills.name: Devices, desks and printouts
skills.description: Handle found devices, unlocked screens, passwords on notes and confidential paper safely.

skills.name: Visitors, doors and tailgating
skills.description: Check who someone is before you let them in or help them, and help genuine people.

skills.name: Payment and invoice fraud
skills.description: Follow the payment process when someone pushes for an urgent wire or new bank details.
